name: Rug cleaning
shortDescription: Wash and dry for wool and flatweave rugs, priced after we see the piece.
includes: A note if the dyes are unstable

process.title: Tell us the size
process.text: Send the length and width in feet and inches, plus the city for pickup.

process.title: We quote
process.text: Wool, silk, and a rug with unstable dyes are not the same job. The quote says which one you have.

process.title: Pickup
process.text: A warehouse route picks the rug up. You do not drop it at a retail counter.

process.title: Wash and return
process.text: We wash, dry fully, and bring it back. A damp rug does not go on the truck.

faq.question: Can you price cleaning from a photo?
faq.answer: A photo starts the quote. The final price follows the measured size and what we find in the foundation.

name: Rug repair
shortDescription: Fringe, edges, and reweaving, quoted from photos and the size of the damage.

process.title: Photograph the damage
process.text: Show the whole rug and a close view of the fringe, edge, or hole.

process.title: We quote the repair
process.text: A worn fringe and a hole in the field are different prices.

process.title: Pickup
process.text: The same routes that deliver rugs can collect one for the workroom.

process.title: Return
process.text: We send photos when the repair is done, then schedule the return.

faq.question: Do you reweave a large loss?
faq.answer: Small losses, yes. A large missing section may not be worth the repair. We will say so before you approve the quote.

name: Custom sizing
shortDescription: Binding or serging when a wool rug needs to fit a measured floor.
includes: Cut and bind on suitable rugs
The finished size in feet and inches
A refusal if the rug should not be cut

process.title: Measure the floor
process.text: Give us the clear width and length in feet and inches, not a guess from a furniture plan.

process.title: We say if it can be cut
process.text: Vintage pieces and some patterns should not be cut. We will decline those.

process.title: Quote
process.text: The quote is for the cut and the binding, not for a new rug.

process.title: Finish
process.text: The edge is bound so it does not unravel. We confirm the finished size before it ships back.

faq.question: Can every rug be cut down?
faq.answer: No. We will not cut a vintage rug or a piece whose pattern would be ruined. The quote is the place we say no.

name: Pickup and delivery
shortDescription: Warehouse delivery and pickup for cleaning or repair, quoted by city and stairs.

process.title: Share the address
process.text: City, floor, and whether there is an elevator or a stair turn.

process.title: We quote the carry
process.text: Street-level delivery and a walk-up are different jobs.

process.title: A weekday window
process.text: The warehouse calls with a window. Someone needs to be there.

process.title: Placement
process.text: We place the rug or furniture in the room. We do not move a household.

faq.question: Is freight free?
faq.answer: Standard freight is free on rugs over $1,500 inside the continental United States. Stairs, furniture, and white-glove placement are quoted.
